title: PagedAttention Virtual Memory Manager for Large-Context KV-Cache
subtitle: Eliminating External Memory Fragmentation, Virtual Page Tables and Block-Level Eviction
problem_statement: An enterprise LLM deployment experiences Out-Of-Memory (OOM) GPU crashes when multiple users submit documents with long context windows (16k to 64k tokens). Memory profiling reveals that 60% of HBM memory is wasted due to static contiguous buffer pre-allocation and external fragmentation.

source_files.content:
class PagedAttentionBlockTable:
    def __init__(self, block_size: int = 16, total_gpu_blocks: int = 10000):
        self.block_size = block_size
        self.free_blocks = list(range(total_gpu_blocks))
        self.block_tables = {} # seq_id -> list[physical_block_id]

    def allocate(self, seq_id: str, num_tokens: int) -> list[int]:
        # Dynamically allocate non-contiguous 16-token physical blocks like OS virtual memory paging
        needed_blocks = (num_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size
        allocated = [self.free_blocks.pop() for _ in range(needed_blocks)]
        self.block_tables[seq_id] = allocated
        return allocated

faded_bug.description: Pre-allocating max context memory contiguous buffers wastes 60%+ of GPU HBM due to internal fragmentation.

invariants.description: System must never crash with CUDA OOM: preempt lowest-priority requests if blocks are exhausted.

probing_ladder.stage_1_validation: Calculate the exact KV-cache size in bytes for a single token in Llama-3-70B (80 layers, 8 KV heads per GQA, hidden dimension 128, FP16).
probing_ladder.stage_2_tightening: When all physical GPU blocks are allocated and a new token is generated, what is the exact preemption protocol (recomputation vs swapping to CPU RAM)?
probing_ladder.stage_3_adversarial: Multiple users share an identical 10,000 token system prompt. How does Prefix Caching with Radix Trees share physical blocks across independent sessions?
probing_ladder.stage_4_squeeze: How does FP8 or INT4 KV-cache quantization impact attention accuracy, perplexity, and memory footprint?

counter_probes.counter_question: If you pre-allocate a 32k buffer for every request, but the average user prompt is only 500 tokens, what is your memory waste percentage?
counter_probes.expected_staff_answer: Over 95% of memory is wasted. PagedAttention allocates blocks on demand (16 tokens per block) like OS virtual memory paging, eliminating internal and external fragmentation.
